name: build-android-apps
description: Build and ship Android apps from your AI assistant: 28 skills (1 frontdoor + 27 specialists), 30 plain-English slash commands, 4 subagents, 5 MCP servers, 5 hooks — progressive disclosure keeps startup under the 8k budget. Per-project resumable build loop with Kahn router.

interface.shortDescription: Build, run, debug, and ship Android apps — one frontdoor skill routes to 27 specialists
interface.longDescription: Use Build Android Apps: $build-android-apps turns a one-line idea into a working app and Play Store submission. Frontdoor classifies intent and delegates to 27 specialists (intake → scaffold → debug → publish). 30 commands are aliases to frontdoor intents (Claude Code and other hosts; on Codex invoke $build-android-apps directly). 5 MCP servers drive adb, Gradle, Play, keystore, assets. Per-project state.json + Kahn router makes every loop resumable and deterministic (no LLM for planning).
defaultPrompt: Build or ship an Android app: use $build-android-apps for anything — it routes to the right specialist. Try 'make a habit tracker with streaks' or 'add dark mode' or 'publish to Play Store'.
